Image credits & production notes

The publications are self-initiated studies. Illustrative businesses, prices and operating figures do not represent commissioned client work or independently verified business results. Photographed buildings, collections and products are credited references, not projects designed by the sample identities.

Presentation images are composed from actual exported pages. Source files exist in INDD and IDML. Photography retains its stated licence; images have been converted and cropped within the layouts. Digital PDFs include attribution. Print exports need the appropriate printer brief, output profile and finishing instructions.
